_about: Rations sold beside the recruits (designed in supplies/rations.csv). Each is placed on a deployed unit. 'shopRank' is the shop rank that first offers it; 'nation' limits it to one side; 'image' is under assets/rations/ (a nation-keyed object when each side has its own picture). The effects are in src/game/engine/rations.js.

telescope.name: Telescope
telescope.text: On a scout: the scout report shows every enemy unit with its numbers. On artillery: +1/+1. On anything else: the scout report shows the enemy's front unit with its numbers. One per unit.

drums.name: Drums
drums.text: Clears the recruits and drafts three of this unit in their place.

colors.name: Colors
colors.text: The shop goes up one rank for the rest of the campaign.

claymore.name: Claymore Sword
claymore.text: Doubles the attack of infantry or cavalry, and the health too of the Scots (Highlanders and Scots Greys). On artillery: +1/+1.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.text: Doubles this unit's attack and health.
